title: An Act to Modify Current Property Tax Assessment Methods to Make Property Taxes Affordable for Longtime Property Owners

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to modify the methods of assessing property taxes on residential properties to help residents retain their homes.

chamber_actions.action: Received by the Clerk of the House on February 20, 2025.
The Bill was REFERRED to the Committee on TAXATION pursuant to Joint Rule 308.2 and ordered printed pursuant to Joint Rule 401.
Carried over, in the same posture, to the next special or regular session of the 132nd Legislature, pursuant to Joint Order SP 519.
Pursuant to Joint Rule 310.3 Placed in Legislative Files (DEAD)
